Subject: Pilot onboarding question: PO vs invoice-only (Onyx SOW attached)

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to kick off the 60‑day pilot (Onyx SOW attached). A quick procurement question: our legal/procurement team prefers issuing a PO for any vendor > $2k/month, but this pilot is expected to be under that threshold and we were hoping to proceed invoice-first to reduce friction.

Can Redwood accept invoice-only onboarding for pilot customers under $5k/mo, or is a PO strictly required? If a PO is required, what is the fastest path to get one in place?

Also looping my procurement alias in case you need standard forms.

Thanks —
Samir

Head of Integrations, Onyx Labs

Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding question: PO vs invoice-only (Onyx SOW attached)

Hi Samir —

Appreciate the SOW and the clear ask. Short answer: we can often do an invoice-only onboarding for pilots under a limited dollar threshold, but finance needs to vet line-of-business risk and we require a few artifacts up front. Proposed path and next steps: 

- We can provision access and start the pilot on an invoice-only basis for up to 30 days (no PO), subject to receipt of the items below and an internal one-time exception approval from Finance.
- Required items from Onyx: W‑9 (or equivalent tax doc), primary billing contact, and a signed pilot SOW.
- Redwood needs a vendor intake form completed so Finance can run risk checks (link below).
- If pilot extends beyond 30 days or spends exceed the agreed threshold, we will request a PO for the remaining term.

Links: vendor intake form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/vendor-intake-form
DocuSign for SOW (if you want): https://docusign.com/onyx-pilot-nda

I'll loop Finance (Monica) and Payments (Logan) to get a quick exception reviewed. If you can send the W‑9 and billing contact today, we should be able to turn this around in 48 hours.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0184

Avery / Logan —

Quick internal notes on risk and approval:

- Threshold: Finance is comfortable with invoice-only for pilots up to $5k total spend provided we collect W‑9 + vendor intake + proof of signing (SOW). We treat this as a temporary exception.
- Controls: Require billing contact + PO/tracking field to be added to the invoice so we can reconcile if a PO is later issued.
- Duration: Approve up to 30 days without a PO. If the pilot generates commit/extension, request PO before renewal.
- Exceptions process: I'll file a one-time exception ticket (FINX-2027-1147) and loop Legal if we see unusual clauses in SOW.

Logan — can you confirm whether any legal redlines in the attached SOW would force procurement to insist on a PO?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
